svg.title: R41 targeted physical projected KKT refinement
svg.desc: Original R40 raw linear: 15 of 33 selected and control starts satisfy the 0.001 physical-KKT tolerance, worst residual 0.010029. Stricter L-BFGS-B: 33 of 33, worst 0.000199. Independent SLSQP: 33 of 33, worst 0.000571. All 18 original exceptional fits passed both restarts. These are outcome-selected reused data, not new independent samples.
svg.text: R41 — physical-gradient refinement of original R40 cases
33 targeted original starts: 18 prior KKT exceptions + 15 paired controls
KKT compliant fits (threshold ≤0.001; all 33 starts retained)
Maximum projected-KKT magnitude: baseline 0.010029; tighter L-BFGS-B 0.000199; independent SLSQP 0.000571.
No new primitive Gaussian blocks; outcome-selected numerical diagnostic only. No inference or release qualification.
